items.q: ______ the public outcry over the data leak that the company's chief executive resigned within a week.
items.vi: Làn sóng phẫn nộ của công chúng về vụ rò rỉ dữ liệu lớn đến mức giám đốc điều hành của công ty đã từ chức trong vòng một tuần.
items.explanation: Fronting Such + be + noun phrase … that inverts subject and verb, and the blank is followed by the noun phrase the public outcry: Such was the public outcry that. ✗ So was — so must be followed by an adjective (So great was the outcry), not directly by a noun; ✗ Such a — clashes with the and leaves the clause with no verb; ✗ So great — no verb before the public outcry.

items.q: Without access to the raw figures, critics can only ______ that the charity inflated its impact numbers.
items.vi: Không được xem số liệu gốc, giới phê bình chỉ có thể phỏng đoán rằng tổ chức từ thiện đã thổi phồng các con số về tác động.
items.explanation: Surmise means to guess or conclude without firm evidence, which is all critics can do without access to the raw figures. ✗ ascertain — find out for certain, impossible without the data; ✗ verify — confirm something is true, again needing the figures; ✗ discern — notice or make out clearly, which implies seeing the evidence.

items.q: The claim that free tuition would bankrupt the state simply does not ______ once you look at the figures.
items.vi: Luận điểm rằng miễn học phí sẽ làm nhà nước phá sản đơn giản là không đứng vững khi ta nhìn vào các con số.
items.explanation: A claim that does not hold water is unsound and collapses under examination — the clue is once you look at the figures. ✗ hold the fort — take charge while someone is away; ✗ hold sway — have power or influence over people; ✗ hold the line — refuse to change a position or price.

items.q: The survey paints a ______ picture of morale in state secondary schools, with two in five teachers planning to leave.
items.vi: Cuộc khảo sát vẽ nên một bức tranh ảm đạm về tinh thần trong các trường trung học công lập, với hai phần năm giáo viên dự định bỏ nghề.
items.explanation: Paint a bleak/gloomy/grim picture is the collocation for a pessimistic account, and two in five teachers planning to leave is bad news. ✗ dim — light that is not bright, or a poor memory; ✗ faint — barely visible or audible; ✗ pale — light in colour, as in a pale face — none describes a hopeless situation.

items.q: The lead author would rather her colleagues ______ the findings to the press until the peer review is complete.
items.vi: Tác giả chính muốn các đồng nghiệp đừng công bố kết quả cho báo chí cho đến khi quá trình bình duyệt hoàn tất.
items.explanation: Would rather + another subject + past subjunctive expresses a wish about the present or future, and here the subject changes to her colleagues: would rather her colleagues didn't release. ✗ don't release — present tense, not the required past form; ✗ wouldn't release — would cannot follow would rather; ✗ not to release — an infinitive follows would rather only with no second subject (would rather not release).

items.q: Ministers met union leaders late into the night in an attempt to ______ a nationwide teachers' strike.
items.vi: Các bộ trưởng đã họp với lãnh đạo công đoàn đến khuya nhằm ngăn chặn một cuộc đình công giáo viên trên toàn quốc.
items.explanation: Head off means to prevent something before it happens, which is why ministers met union leaders late into the night about a strike. ✗ head for — move towards a place; ✗ head up — lead or be in charge of a team; ✗ head back — return to where you came from.

items.q: The online scholarship scheme ______ that every applicant has reliable internet access, which is far from true in rural provinces.
items.vi: Chương trình học bổng trực tuyến mặc nhiên coi rằng mọi ứng viên đều có kết nối internet ổn định, điều hoàn toàn không đúng ở các tỉnh nông thôn.
items.explanation: To presuppose is to take something for granted as a starting condition — the scheme silently assumes internet access, which is far from true. ✗ predicts — says something will happen in future; ✗ perceives — notices or becomes aware, which a scheme cannot do; ✗ proposes — suggests a plan, but the scheme is not suggesting access, it assumes it.

items.q: Rather than ______ the buck to the previous administration, the new minister ______ full responsibility for the failed reform.
items.vi: Thay vì đổ trách nhiệm cho chính quyền tiền nhiệm, tân bộ trưởng đã nhận hoàn toàn trách nhiệm về cuộc cải cách thất bại.
items.explanation: The idiom is pass the buck (shift blame to someone else), and one accepts or takes responsibility; Rather than … the new minister contrasts blaming with owning up. ✗ push / took — took works, but the idiom is never push the buck; ✗ throw / accepted — throw the buck is not an idiom; ✗ pass / made — you do not make responsibility.

items.q: Field researchers now carry satellite phones ______ the mobile network fails in the more remote provinces.
items.vi: Các nhà nghiên cứu thực địa hiện mang theo điện thoại vệ tinh phòng khi mạng di động mất sóng ở những tỉnh xa xôi hơn.
items.explanation: In case + present simple names a precaution against something that may happen: they carry phones in case the network fails. ✗ unless — 'if it does not fail', which makes no sense as a reason to carry a phone; ✗ so that — states a purpose, and a network failure is not the aim; ✗ as long as — 'provided that', a condition, not a possible risk.

items.q: The foundation deliberately works in villages that are ______, where the larger aid agencies rarely venture.
items.vi: Quỹ này cố tình hoạt động ở những ngôi làng hẻo lánh ít người lui tới, nơi các tổ chức viện trợ lớn hiếm khi đặt chân đến.
items.explanation: Off the beaten track describes a remote place few people visit — where the larger aid agencies rarely venture. ✗ off the record — said unofficially, not for publication; ✗ off the hook — freed from blame or a duty; ✗ off the cuff — said without preparation.

items.q: The auditors ______ the discrepancy months earlier, yet somehow it went unnoticed until a whistle-blower came forward.
items.vi: Các kiểm toán viên lẽ ra đã có thể phát hiện sai lệch từ nhiều tháng trước, vậy mà không hiểu sao nó vẫn không bị phát hiện cho đến khi một người tố giác lên tiếng.
items.explanation: Could have + past participle describes a past possibility that did not happen, and yet it went unnoticed confirms nobody spotted it. ✗ must have spotted — a deduction that they did spot it, contradicted by the second clause; ✗ can't have spotted — a deduction that spotting was impossible, yet the sentence says they had the chance; ✗ needn't have spotted — means they spotted it unnecessarily, which never happened.

items.q: From the guarded tone of the reference, we can ______ that her former manager was less than impressed with her work.
items.vi: Từ giọng điệu dè dặt của thư giới thiệu, ta có thể suy ra rằng người quản lý cũ không mấy ấn tượng với công việc của cô ấy.
items.explanation: The reader draws a conclusion, so the verb is infer; From the guarded tone shows we are working out a hidden meaning, not sending one. ✗ imply — the writer suggests indirectly; it is the manager, not we, who implies; ✗ insinuate — hint something unpleasant, again the writer's action; ✗ allude — refer indirectly, and it needs to, not a that-clause.

items.q: The embezzlement scandal has done ______ damage to the charity's reputation among its long-standing donors.
items.vi: Vụ bê bối biển thủ đã gây thiệt hại khôn lường cho uy tín của tổ chức từ thiện trong mắt các nhà tài trợ lâu năm.
items.explanation: Untold damage means damage too great to be counted or described — a scandal among long-standing donors is that serious. ✗ unspoken — felt but not said aloud, as in an unspoken rule; ✗ unsaid — left without being said; ✗ unmentioned — not referred to — all three describe words, not the scale of damage.

items.q: ______, the three studies suggest that screen time has a far smaller effect on children's sleep than parents fear.
items.vi: Gộp lại, ba nghiên cứu cho thấy thời gian dùng màn hình ảnh hưởng đến giấc ngủ của trẻ ít hơn nhiều so với những gì cha mẹ lo sợ.
items.explanation: The studies are considered together by the reader, so the passive past participle Taken together is needed, and its subject is the three studies. ✗ Taking together — active participle makes the studies do the taking; ✗ Having taken together — active perfect participle, same wrong agent; ✗ To take together — an infinitive of purpose, but the studies have no purpose here.

items.q: With the education budget frozen, plans for a new vocational college have been put ______ until at least next year.
items.vi: Với ngân sách giáo dục bị đóng băng, kế hoạch xây trường cao đẳng nghề mới đã bị gác lại ít nhất đến năm sau.
items.explanation: To put something on the back burner is to postpone it — the clue is budget frozen and until at least next year. ✗ on the front line — where the fighting or hardest work is; ✗ on the back foot — at a disadvantage, forced to defend; ✗ on the cards — likely to happen, the opposite of postponed.

items.q: Whether the merger goes ahead will ______ the outcome of Friday's shareholder vote.
items.vi: Việc sáp nhập có được tiến hành hay không sẽ phụ thuộc vào kết quả cuộc bỏ phiếu của cổ đông vào thứ Sáu.
items.explanation: Hinge on means to depend entirely on, and whether the merger goes ahead is decided by the vote. ✗ hold on — wait, or grip something tightly; ✗ hand on — pass something to the next person; ✗ home in on — move straight towards a target or focus on it.

items.q: It is high time the government ______ teachers' pay to that of comparable graduate professions.
items.vi: Đã đến lúc chính phủ phải gắn lương giáo viên với mức lương của các ngành nghề tốt nghiệp đại học tương đương.
items.explanation: It is high time + subject + past subjunctive says something should already have been done: high time the government linked. ✗ links — present simple, but high time needs the past form; ✗ link — a base-form subjunctive follows suggest/demand, not high time; ✗ has linked — present perfect would mean it is already done, the opposite of the complaint.

items.q: The trustees ______ the proposal too risky to fund, despite the founder's enthusiasm for it.
items.vi: Các ủy viên quản trị cho rằng đề xuất này quá rủi ro để tài trợ, bất chấp sự nhiệt tình của người sáng lập.
items.explanation: Deem + object + adjective takes no preposition, so it fits ______ the proposal too risky directly. ✗ regarded — needs as (regarded the proposal as too risky); ✗ viewed — also needs as; ✗ looked — needs on/upon … as to mean 'consider', and looked the proposal is not English.

items.q: Having lost its final appeal, the trust had no choice but ______ the disputed funds to the donor's estate.
items.vi: Sau khi thua kháng cáo cuối cùng, quỹ không còn lựa chọn nào khác ngoài việc trả lại số tiền tranh chấp cho di sản của nhà tài trợ.
items.explanation: Have no choice/alternative but + to-infinitive is the fixed pattern: no choice but to return. ✗ return — the bare infinitive follows cannot but or do nothing but, not have no choice but; ✗ returning — a gerund does not follow this but; ✗ to returning — to here is part of the infinitive, so an -ing form cannot follow it.

items.q: A one-off retention bonus will merely ______; it will do nothing about the culture that is driving nurses out of the profession.
items.vi: Một khoản thưởng giữ chân một lần chỉ che đậy tạm thời vấn đề; nó chẳng làm gì được với văn hóa đang đẩy các y tá rời bỏ nghề.
items.explanation: To paper over the cracks is to hide a problem rather than solve it, and it will do nothing about the culture spells that out. ✗ read between the lines — find a hidden meaning in what is said; ✗ clutch at straws — try anything out of desperation; ✗ slip through the cracks — be overlooked by a system, which a bonus cannot do.

items.q: ______ progress has been made on narrowing the attainment gap, but far less than the ministry's press release suggests.
items.vi: Đã có một số tiến bộ trong việc thu hẹp khoảng cách thành tích, nhưng ít hơn nhiều so với những gì thông cáo báo chí của bộ gợi ý.
items.explanation: Progress is an uncountable noun (no plural, no a), so it takes some. ✗ A few — only with plural countable nouns (a few schools); ✗ Many — plural countable nouns only; with uncountables it would be much; ✗ Several — plural countable nouns only.

items.q: While ______ through a decade of old survey data, the analyst ______ a pattern that nobody in the department had noticed.
items.vi: Trong lúc sàng lọc dữ liệu khảo sát cũ suốt một thập kỷ, nhà phân tích tình cờ phát hiện ra một quy luật mà chưa ai trong phòng để ý.
items.explanation: Sift through is to examine a mass of material carefully, and hit on is to discover by chance — a pattern nobody had noticed. ✗ shifting / hit on — shift means to move, a spelling near-miss for sift; ✗ sorting / hit at — sorting through is possible, but hit at means to strike or attack indirectly; ✗ sifting / hit out — hit out is to attack in words.

items.q: Only after the audit was made public ______ how much of their money had gone on administration.
items.vi: Chỉ sau khi báo cáo kiểm toán được công bố, các nhà tài trợ mới nhận ra bao nhiêu tiền của họ đã đi vào chi phí hành chính.
items.explanation: A fronted Only after + clause forces subject–auxiliary inversion in the main clause: did donors realise. ✗ donors realised — no inversion after the fronted Only after; ✗ donors did realise — subject before auxiliary, so still not inverted; ✗ had donors realised — inverted, but the past perfect belongs to the earlier event (the audit), not the later realising.

items.q: Few head teachers could ______ of a timetable with no standardised testing at all.
items.vi: Ít hiệu trưởng nào có thể hình dung nổi một thời khóa biểu hoàn toàn không có kỳ thi chuẩn hóa.
items.explanation: Conceive of means to imagine something as possible, and it is the only option that takes of before a timetable. ✗ perceive — notice or see, transitive with no of; ✗ contemplate — think about seriously, takes a direct object; ✗ consider — think carefully about, also takes a direct object without of.

items.q: The central bank has raised interest rates twice this quarter in a bid to ______ inflation without tipping the economy into recession.
items.vi: Ngân hàng trung ương đã hai lần tăng lãi suất trong quý này nhằm kiềm chế lạm phát mà không đẩy nền kinh tế vào suy thoái.
items.explanation: Curb inflation/spending/emissions is the collocation for keeping something under control, which is why the bank raised interest rates. ✗ deter — discourage a person or a crime, not a rate; ✗ quench — goes with thirst or fire; ✗ shrink — make a deficit or workforce smaller, not the usual verb for inflation.
